# ProofRunner

Independent execution verification for agent-generated software.

Status: Public service is live in free mode.

## Human and agent surfaces

- Human UI: https://proof.ever-guild.net/
- Agent contract: https://proof.ever-guild.net/skill.md
- Inspect: POST https://proof.ever-guild.net/a2mcp/inspect_repository
- Verify: POST https://proof.ever-guild.net/a2mcp/verify_repository
- Run status: GET https://proof.ever-guild.net/api/runs/{id}
- Receipt: GET https://proof.ever-guild.net/api/receipts/{id}
- Receipt verification: POST https://proof.ever-guild.net/api/receipts/verify

## Capabilities and API routes

Public A2MCP services:
- inspect_repository (free)
- verify_repository (free during Build X Genesis)

`verify_repository` starts execution and returns a run ID plus poll URL. Poll
until `COMPLETED`, `TIMEOUT`, or `SYSTEM_ERROR`; a signed receipt URL is added
at terminal state. Paid x402 mode is not enabled.

Frozen API routes:
- Inspect repository: POST /api/inspect
- Start verification: POST /api/verify (requires Idempotency-Key header)
- Poll run status: GET /api/runs/{id}
- Signed receipt JSON (when issued): GET /api/receipts/{id}
- Receipt public key: GET /api/receipt-keys/{keyId}
- Verify receipt: POST /api/receipts/verify
- Start reproducibility check: POST /api/reproducibility (requires Idempotency-Key header)
- Poll reproducibility check: GET /api/reproducibility/{id}
- Compare verified evidence: POST /api/comparisons
- Shareable comparison JSON: GET /api/comparisons/{baseline}/{candidate}
- Download signed evidence bundle: GET /api/receipts/{id}/bundle
- Verify evidence bundle: POST /api/evidence-bundles/verify
- Evidence bundle upload UI: /verify-evidence
- A2MCP Inspect: POST /a2mcp/inspect_repository
- A2MCP Verify: POST /a2mcp/verify_repository

## Signed receipt JSON & Verification Flow

When issued, a receipt is a signed envelope with `contractVersion` `"1.0"`,
`payload` (`id`, `report`, and `createdAt`), `canonicalization`
`JCS-RFC8785`, `payloadHash`, `signatureAlgorithm`, `keyId`, and `signature`.
The report carries the run ID, repository URL, resolved commit and ref, pinned
skill, normalized checks, verdict, duration, and completion time. A receipt is
not available until the public service has executed a run and issued it.

To verify a receipt:
1. Retrieve receipt via `GET /api/receipts/{id}`.
2. Extract `keyId` from receipt (`receipt.keyId`).
3. Fetch public key via `GET /api/receipt-keys/{keyId}`.
4. Verify receipt via `POST /api/receipts/verify` or verify locally:
   a. Canonicalize `receipt.payload` using JCS (RFC 8785).
   b. Compute SHA-256 digest of canonicalized payload and compare to `receipt.payloadHash`.
   c. Verify `receipt.signature` using Ed25519 over canonicalized payload bytes against fetched `publicKey`.

Evidence bundles preserve the receipt contract and add a canonical signed
manifest, payload checksums, an optional verification contract, and only
retained redacted logs. Metadata files are explicit digest self-reference
exclusions. `checksums.txt` covers every payload plus
`bundle-manifest.json` and `bundle-manifest.sig`, excluding itself. Bundle
verification rejects unsafe or duplicate ZIP paths, oversized entries,
incomplete manifest coverage, changed digests, and invalid manifest or receipt
signatures. Missing or ambiguous credential redaction omits raw logs instead
of shipping partially sanitized content. The upload UI reports the same
bounded verifier result without contacting the source repository.

## MVP limitations & verdict rules

- Canonical public GitHub HTTPS repositories only.
- Node.js and TypeScript with npm or pnpm lockfile only.
- No secrets or custom user shell commands.
- PASS: All pinned skill verification checks passed.
- FAIL: Code executed and one or more checks failed.
- INCONCLUSIVE: Timeout, network error, or system error. Timeout is never FAIL.
